entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi... I hope you can help me. I need to return something and I'm just so disappointed.
I'm sorry to hear you're feeling disappointed. I can certainly look into a return for you. Can I start with your order number?
Yes, it's VF902-10-C. I've been a VeloFit customer for a long time, and I saved up for these. I was just really hoping they would work out.

I appreciate you being a loyal customer, and I understand. I see the order is for the VeloFit Spin Class Shoes. To make sure I'm helping correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the shoe or more of a preference or fit issue?

It's the fit. The cycling shoes just don't feel right on my feet. I used them for one class and they gave me awful blisters on my heels. I can't possibly wear them again, and I really needed that money back.

Oh, getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers, and I completely understand why you'd want to return them. Let me just pull up your delivery date and review the policy for you. One moment.

Okay, thank you for waiting. I see here that the shoes were delivered 9 days ago. According to our policy, you have 90 days from the delivery date for a return. So you are well within the window to get a full refund.
Oh, thank goodness. That's such a relief. Are you sure? That's wonderful.

Absolutely. I've just processed the return authorization for you. I'm sending an email to you now with a prepaid shipping label. Just make sure to include the shoes and the original cleats in the box. Once our warehouse receives the return, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
Thank you so much, Charlie. You have no idea how much this helps. I was so worried.
It's my pleasure to help. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thank you again.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
